method_detail: tools/research/band_step_check.py --live and band_step_live_report.py, no entity and no services, CPU. Real stimulus (shipped arm: melody and outside voice; none arm: without them), real Audition acoustic path, the shipped affect module (make_affect, regulation off) as audition's arousal provider, ticking once a second and on every broadcast; rests from the sleep module's developmental state cycle ([sleep] developmental_rest_s 1410 s every 2996 awake s; forward model suspended, affect bins on the entity clock, dwell standing still, affective reset at the end); broadcast context from the real Workspace with the shipped salience at the AccessRateController's rate over audition and affect events. Left out: vision, interoception and self-rhythm events in the broadcast, the coherence layer and broadcast feedback. Seeds 1-3, settled schedule (5 awake h per stage) and the release rule. Boredom's deprivation share from the welfare observer's AffectWelfareTally (task 3.2).
results: Live conditions keep steps 1 and 2 mostly under lp_0. The error still rises 3.4 to 4.2 times in the first minute after steps 1 and 2, but the full-span reading is at or above lp_0 in only 3 to 18% of awake readings in stages 0 to 2 (offline 46 to 87%). Under the rule every stage is released 4591 to 6061 awake s in (1.3 to 1.7 h) and the schedule completes in 5.7 to 6.0 awake hours. Rests shorten the full span: the first full-span reading arrives 3991 awake s after each step instead of 5400, with 26% of its window in rest; 23 of 24 rule releases fall below span plus window (6000 awake s). Boredom deprivation share over awake time: settled 0.77 with the added sounds, 0.78 to 0.83 without; under the rule 0.80 to 0.86 with, 0.79 to 0.89 without. Arousal while awake averages 0.44 to 0.51 (p90 up to 0.77 in stages 3 and 4, alerts 108 to 191 per awake hour).
